title: CSI IND — Index (line feed)
summary: ESC D (IND) moves the cursor down one line, scrolling the screen up if the cursor is at the bottom of the scroll region. Equivalent to LF but without the carriage return.

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: the CSI sequence ends at its final byte.

params.name: IND
params.meaning: ESC D moves the cursor down one line; scrolls up if at the bottom margin.

gotchas: IND is ESC D (a C1 control).
LF (0x0A) often behaves like IND + CR depending on the terminal's LNM (line feed/new line mode).
IND respects the scroll region set by DECSTBM (CSI r).

v1_smoke_test.asserts: CSI sequence renders as a byte-exact sequence with final byte 'D'.
